name: spacebar
description: A browser a blind person can drive by voice: hold the space bar, say what you want, and it acts on the page — asking first, out loud, with the values, before anything is sent.

scripts.verify: npm run check:manifest && npm run check:globals && npm run check:syntax && npm test
scripts.prepare: if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; fi
